laws.rule: Parts of Rasuwa (Gosaikunda ward 1) and Dolakha (Gaurishankar ward 9, Bigu ward 1) need a restricted area permit of USD 20 a person a week. Restricted areas are closed to free individual trekkers: the Department of Immigration issues the permit only through a licensed agency, for a group, and not beyond your visa's expiry. Fees are quoted in US dollars and paid in Nepali rupees.

sites.name: Kathmandu Valley monument zones
sites.era: Licchavi to Malla periods, about 5th to 18th centuries
sites.what: Durbar squares of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur, and the Swayambhu, Boudha, Pashupati and Changu Narayan temples (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.tickets: Foreign nationals: Kathmandu Durbar Square NPR 1,000; Patan Durbar Square NPR 1,000; Bhaktapur Durbar Square USD 18 or NPR 1,800 (about AUD 26); Pashupatinath NPR 1,000 a day per entry; Boudha NPR 400; Swayambhu NPR 200; Changunarayan NPR 300. Under 10s free at several sites. Pay at the entry point.
access.closures: At Pashupatinath, tourists view the temple from the back premises.
